blocks.name: ula32_mips
blocks.responsibility: Execute the MIPS ALU operation selected by alu_control and derive the zero flag from its result.
blocks.design_rationale: A single combinational process implements all operations. This minimizes area and latency for the unpipelined MIPS datapath (NFR-01) and uses numeric_std for portable signed arithmetic (NFR-02).

alternatives.tradeoff: Makes carry propagation explicit for teaching, but adds structural complexity without improving the required combinational interface.
Concise, synthesizable description that lets the synthesis tool select the implementation.
